```yaml

id: vuln-braces-abdafb0c
languages:
  - javascript
message: Potential security vulnerability in brace usage.
severity: ERROR
metadata:
  CVE: CVE-2018-1109
  CWE: CWE-185, CWE-400
pattern: 
  metavar: "vulnerable_brace_usage"
  metavar-regex: "^\\{(,+(?:(\\{,+\\})*),*|,*(?:(\\{,+\\})*),+\\}\\}$"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode: "regex"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode-regex: "^\\{((?:,|\\{,+\\})+)\\}$"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode-regex-taint-mode: "tainted"
  metavar-regex-taint-mode-regex-taint-mode-regex: "tainted"
  metavar-taint-mode: "tainted"
```
This Semgrep rule will detect the vulnerable behavior of the brace usage in the provided JavaScript code. It uses regular expressions to match the vulnerable pattern and taint mode to identify the tainted part of the code. The rule is marked as an ERROR severity to highlight the potential security vulnerability.
